description: Truth Social account and its latest posts: profile (name, followers, following, post count, verified, website, joined) and up to 20 newest posts with text, time, replies, reposts, likes, media URLs, link card and repost/quote flags. From truthsocial.com's public Mastodon-style API through a residential proxy. Usually answers in about 9 s, up to 16 s on slower calls; allow a 30 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_pinterest when you need latest pins of a public Pinterest profile from Pinterest's; social_instagram when you need engagement snapshot of a public Instagram account. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
